title: Design Browser History
statement: Single-tab browser with homepage. visit(url) clears forward history; back(steps) and forward(steps) move at most steps and return the current URL.

examples.input: homepage=leetcode.com; visit(google.com), visit(facebook.com), visit(youtube.com), back(1), back(1), forward(1), visit(linkedin.com), forward(2), back(2), back(7)

notes: Only one example was retrieved from the source; no other example was invented. Output list uses null for visit calls.
